messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: MSEM with lavaan: centering
parts:
On 05/04/2018 12:08 PM, franz...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I was wondering how / where I can make lavaan centering variables group-
> vs. grand mean?
> And what is the default?

lavaan decomposes level-1 variabels into a within and a between
component; this results in latent variables (for within and between),
but the approach is similar to cluster-centering.

Can't change this.

Yves.
